RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: WITH RequiredPerms AS ( SELECT 'Application.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'Group.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'GroupMember.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'User.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'User-PasswordProfile.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'UserAuthenticationMethod.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'Directory.ReadWrite.All' AS Perm UNION ALL SELECT 'RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory' AS Perm ), MissingPerms AS ( SELECT Perm FROM RequiredPerms WHERE Perm NOT IN (SELECT value FROM ResourcePerms) ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MissingPerms) THEN 'Fail to verify the presence of all necessary write permissions: missing permissions - ' || (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(Perm, ', ') FROM MissingPerms) ELSE 'Successfully able to verify the presence of all necessary write permissions' END AS message, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MissingPerms) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS success;
